public class OverdrawDetector extends Detector implements XmlScanner, SourceCodeScanner {

    public static final Issue ISSUE = Issue.create(
            "Overdraw",
            "Painting regions more than once",
            "If you set a background drawable on a root view, then you should use a " +
            "custom theme where the theme background is null. Otherwise, the theme background " +
            "will be painted first, only to have your custom background completely cover it; " +
            "this is called \"overdraw\".\n\n" +
            "NOTE: This detector relies on figuring out which layouts are associated with " +
            "which activities based on scanning the Java code, and it's currently doing that " +
            "using an inexact pattern matching algorithm. Therefore, it can incorrectly " +
            "conclude which activity the layout is associated with and then wrongly complain " +
            "that a background-theme is hidden.\n\n" +
            "If you want your custom background on multiple pages, then you should consider " +
            "making a custom theme with your custom background and just using that theme " +
            "instead of a root element background.\n\n" +
            "Of course it's possible that your custom drawable is translucent and you want " +
            "it to be mixed with the background. However, you will get better performance " +
            "if you pre-mix the background with your drawable and use that resulting image or " +
            "color as a custom theme background instead.",
            Category.PERFORMANCE,
            3,
            Severity.WARNING,
            new Implementation(OverdrawDetector.class, Scope.JAVA_AND_RESOURCE_FILES));

    private final Map<String, Location> layoutsWithRootBackground = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, String> activityToTheme = new HashMap<>();
    private String applicationTheme = null;

    private static final Set<String> TRANSPARENT_THEMES = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
            "@android:style/Theme.Translucent",
            "@android:style/Theme.Dialog",
            "@android:style/Theme.Holo.Dialog",
            "@android:style/Theme.Holo.DialogWhenLarge",
            "@android:style/Theme.Holo.Dialog.MinWidth",
            "@android:style/Theme.Holo.Dialog.NoActionBar",
            "@android:style/Theme.Holo.Dialog.NoActionBar.MinWidth",
            "@android:style/Theme.Holo.Panel",
            "@android:style/Theme.Holo.Light.Panel",
            "@android:style/Theme.Material.Dialog",
            "@android:style/Theme.Material.DialogWhenLarge",
            "@android:style/Theme.Material.Dialog.MinWidth",
            "@android:style/Theme.Material.Dialog.NoActionBar",
            "@android:style/Theme.Material.Dialog.NoActionBar.MinWidth",
            "@android:style/Theme.Material.Panel",
            "@android:style/Theme.Material.Light.Panel",
            "@android:style/Theme.Translucent.NoTitleBar",
            "@android:style/Theme.Translucent.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen",
            "@android:style/Theme.Wallpaper",
            "@android:style/Theme.Wallpaper.NoTitleBar",
            "@android:style/Theme.Wallpaper.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Dialog",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.DialogWhenLarge",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Dialog.MinWidth",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Dialog.NoActionBar",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Dialog.NoActionBar.MinWidth",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Panel",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Light.Panel",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Wallpaper",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Wallpaper.NoTitleBar",
            "@android:style/Theme.DeviceDefault.Wallpaper.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen"
    ));

    @Override
    public void beforeCheckEachProject(Context context) {
        layoutsWithRootBackground.clear();
        activityToTheme.clear();
        applicationTheme = null;
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<String> getApplicableElements() {
        return Collections.singletonList("*");
    }

    @Override
    public void visitElement(XmlContext context, Element element) {
        Node parent = element.getParentNode();
        if (parent == null || parent.getNodeType() != Node.DOCUMENT_NODE) {
            return;
        }

        String fileName = context.file.getName();
        if (fileName.equals(SdkConstants.ANDROID_MANIFEST_XML)) {
            visitManifestElement(context, element);
            return;
        }

        ResourceFolderType folderType = context.getResourceFolderType();
        if (folderType == ResourceFolderType.LAYOUT) {
            String background = element.getAttributeNS(SdkConstants.ANDROID_URI, SdkConstants.ATTR_BACKGROUND);
            if (background != null && !background.isEmpty()) {
                String layoutName = fileName.indexOf('.') != -1 ? fileName.substring(0, fileName.lastIndexOf('.')) : fileName;
                layoutsWithRootBackground.put(layoutName, context.getLocation(element));
            }
        }
    }

    private void visitManifestElement(XmlContext context, Element element) {
        String tag = element.getTagName();
        if (SdkConstants.TAG_APPLICATION.equals(tag)) {
            applicationTheme = element.getAttributeNS(SdkConstants.ANDROID_URI, SdkConstants.ATTR_THEME);
        } else if (SdkConstants.TAG_ACTIVITY.equals(tag) || SdkConstants.TAG_ACTIVITY_ALIAS.equals(tag)) {
            String name = element.getAttributeNS(SdkConstants.ANDROID_URI, SdkConstants.ATTR_NAME);
            String theme = element.getAttributeNS(SdkConstants.ANDROID_URI, SdkConstants.ATTR_THEME);
            if (name != null && !name.isEmpty()) {
                String simpleName = name.substring(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
                activityToTheme.put(simpleName, theme != null && !theme.isEmpty() ? theme : applicationTheme);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> getApplicableMethodNames() {
        return Collections.singletonList("setContentView");
    }

    @Override
    public void visitMethodCall(JavaContext context, UCallExpression call, PsiMethod method) {
        // Java scanning is optional for this detector's core functionality.
        // We keep it for potential future activity-layout mapping enhancements.
    }

    @Override
    public void afterCheckEachProject(Context context) {
        String defaultTheme = applicationTheme;
        if (defaultTheme == null || defaultTheme.isEmpty()) {
            defaultTheme = "@android:style/Theme";
        }

        for (Map.Entry<String, Location> entry : layoutsWithRootBackground.entrySet()) {
            String layoutName = entry.getKey();
            Location location = entry.getValue();

            // Check if any known theme for this layout is transparent.
            // Since we don't strictly map layouts to activities here, we use the app theme.
            // If the app theme is transparent, we skip warning.
            if (!isTransparentTheme(defaultTheme)) {
                String message = String.format(
                        "Possible overdraw: Root element paints background `%s` with a theme that also paints a background (inferred theme is `%s`)",
                        layoutName, defaultTheme);
                context.report(ISSUE, location, message, null);
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean isTransparentTheme(String theme) {
        if (theme == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (TRANSPARENT_THEMES.contains(theme)) {
            return true;
        }
        String lower = theme.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        return lower.contains(".translucent") || lower.contains(".dialog") ||
               lower.contains(".panel") || lower.contains(".wallpaper") ||
               lower.contains("@null") || lower.contains("@android:color/transparent");
    }
}
